rows.label: bf11440100_0020
rows.name: You didn't make it in time?

rows.label: bf11440100_0030
rows.name: Was that the child from that house?

rows.label: bf11440100_0040
rows.name:
That soldier... wasn't
he the one you...?

rows.label: bf11440100_0070
rows.name:
Acedia's collection includes
many paintings of hell.

rows.label: bf11440100_0080
rows.name:
But maybe the real thing is more like this
than you'd expect.

rows.label: bf11440100_0100
rows.name:
The salvation of the people...
That's what's wanted...
